notes.title: "Loot Line - Season 2" available for wishlist and a quick word from our studio
notes.content: [h3][b]The Adventure Continues![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]For those who loved the original [b]Loot Line[/b], get ready to set sail once more! [b]Loot Line - Season 2[/b] builds on everything you enjoyed in the first game, offering an even grander pirate adventure. This time, you'll explore a sprawling fantasy world with new treacherous waters to navigate and ancient secrets to uncover.[/p][p]Game will contain rich storytelling and unique characters you know and love while expanding the world with even more daring escapades. It's a journey filled with unforgettable encounters and new kinks to discover.[/p][p]By [b]wishlisting the game[/b], you'll be the first to know about updates, announcements, and the official release date. It's a huge help for us and ensures you won't miss a single moment of the action!     [/p][p][/p][p][b]A quick note from us[/b][/p][p][/p][p]We also want to be transparent with you about some changes happening behind the scenes. To ensure our games meet the high standards you deserve, we've recently restructured our development team. This change marks a new beginning for us, one focused on professional growth and better-quality games.[/p][p]From now on, you can expect a much stronger community presence from us, as we will try to address any issue you bump into while playing our games. Our goal is to create better games and build a stronger relationship with all of you.[/p][p]Thank you for your understanding as we move forward![/p]
